question: Does the immediately previous closed lifecycle of any one strategy create a causal positive-versus-nonpositive outcome-memory state that changes the next lifecycle's stressed return and stop-loss incidence broadly and materially enough to justify one later strategy-specific, entry-preserving response question?

current_path_hash_manifest.algorithm: Sort root-relative path|uppercase file SHA-256, join with LF, SHA-256 UTF-8.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row. state_sequence is a state version, not an event primary key.
fixed_reconstruction.ordering: Within each period order by parsed server_time, numeric state_sequence, fixed event precedence and source path plus source line.
fixed_reconstruction.market_birth: OPEN begins RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure or Return lifecycle and supplies planned_risk from detail.
fixed_reconstruction.passive_birth: PASSIVE_PLACE stores planned risk; only PASSIVE_FILL begins an admitted Passive lifecycle.
fixed_reconstruction.close: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends one active lifecycle; value_b is native stressed net USD and detail reason=DEAL_REASON_SL marks a stop exit.
fixed_reconstruction.stressed_r: close value_b divided by positive birth planned_risk.
fixed_reconstruction.memory_scope: Within each strategy and period only. The first lifecycle of every strategy-period is excluded because fresh Tester periods share no causal prior state.

previous_state.PREV_POSITIVE: immediately previous same-strategy lifecycle stressed_r is greater than zero
previous_state.PREV_NONPOSITIVE: immediately previous same-strategy lifecycle stressed_r is at most zero

fixed_integrity_gate: All six files retain the listed byte lengths and hashes and contain zero exact duplicate full rows.
Every admitted lifecycle has one positive planned risk and exactly one CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE; no strategy overlaps itself.
Reconstruct exactly 2,233 lifecycles: RC16 272, RC4 206, Cross 805, Pressure 118, Return 238 and Passive 594.
Stressed net sums exactly to 407.0477 USD and stop exits exactly to 206.
Exclude exactly 24 first strategy-period lifecycles and form exactly 2,209 causal previous-to-current pairs.
Every pair's previous close server time is strictly earlier than or equal to the current birth time, with fixed equal-time close-before-birth precedence.

density: At least 40 PREV_POSITIVE and 40 PREV_NONPOSITIVE pairs pooled.
Both states have at least eight pairs in at least three periods.
Both states are each at least 15 percent of the strategy's pooled pairs.
economic_effect: Absolute pooled PREV_NONPOSITIVE-minus-PREV_POSITIVE mean current stressed_r is at least 0.10R.
At least three of four period mean differences share the pooled sign, considering only periods with at least eight pairs in both states.
stop_coherence: Absolute pooled PREV_NONPOSITIVE-minus-PREV_POSITIVE stop-rate difference is at least 0.05.
At least three eligible periods share the pooled stop-rate sign.
The stressed-r and stop-rate effects are economically coherent: lower after-nonpositive stressed_r requires higher stop incidence, or higher stressed_r requires lower stop incidence.
fixed_information_gate.selection: Select at most one passing strategy by larger absolute pooled stressed-r difference, then larger absolute stop-rate difference, then more same-sign economic periods, then more pooled pairs, then lexicographic strategy name.
fixed_information_gate.passing_action: Retain one later strategy-specific, entry-preserving outcome-memory response Proxy question. Unit 023 selects no response type, size ratio, hold change, threshold, EA or Live candidate; any later Proxy must keep every base opportunity eligible at no less than base minimum lot and compare the whole six-strategy portfolio.
fixed_information_gate.failure_action: Close with no outcome-memory response question. Do not rescue with previous-R magnitude, streak length, time decay, cross-strategy memory, pooled strategy rule, direction, symbol, weekday or period exception.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before reading pair outcomes.
Run exactly one aggregation over the six frozen files.
Do not inspect a second previous state, alternate sign threshold or subgroup inside Unit 023.
Do not run MT5, add MQL, create a reusable analysis CLI or touch Live.
Do not reopen or repair Unit 022.
